matched.detail: All four targets are iPhone-only, portrait-only where applicable, and minimum iOS 15.0.
All ten approved authorization categories and denial fallbacks remain represented.
GET /health, public GET /config with ETag/304, and POST /sync are implemented; /config accepts no PII and cannot expand permissions or tracking.
Widget and both notification extensions are embedded product targets with no AppMetrica activation.
In-app full-profile deletion UI and backend operation exist; production persistence and backup purge remain external blockers.
Report and block flows exist; production filtering, public moderation contact, and response operations remain blocked.
AppMetrica 6.5.0 Core/Crashes/AdSupport are exact-pinned and gated by consent, valid key, kill switch, and ATT for IDFA.
Seven implemented-app screenshots use fictional data, accepted 1320x2868 portrait dimensions, JPEG encoding, and no alpha channel.

driftResolvedDuringReleasePreparation.resolution: Added ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false after confirming only TLS, CryptoKit/Security/CommonCrypto platform APIs are used; final dependency questionnaire still requires confirmation.
Added purchase_history to the conservative disclosure source because AppMetricaCore 6.5.0 declares it, while noting YPerson does not use Revenue or ECommerce APIs.
